question: Find the top-selling product among customers who bought 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley' in July 2017, excluding itself.
sql:
-- Find top-selling product (by quantity) among customers who bought 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley' in July 2017, excluding that product itself
WITH customers_who_bought AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`, 
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men\'s Vintage Henley'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName AS product_name, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, 
UNNEST(hits) AS h
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
  AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM customers_who_bought)
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men\'s Vintage Henley'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1
